summaryZh: Gorman昼夜节律实验室研究生物钟的组成、多个生物钟之间的相互作用，以及生物时间对药物影响和动物生命历程的作用。它使用动物模型探索调整人体生物钟、帮助轮班工作者的策略。
researchQuestions: 多个昼夜节律时钟如何相互作用？
如何调整生物钟以帮助轮班工作者？

evidence.quote: 1. Understanding how the circadian clock is put together 2. Learning how individual multiple circadian clocks interact with one another 3. Using animal models to develop strategies for adjustment of human clocks to help shift-workers
the Gorman Circadian Rhythms Lab is part of the UCSD Center for Chronobiology

4. Examining how the timing drug exposure (e.g., alcohol, amphetamine may contribute to the effects of drugs and the development of addiction 5. Studying how biological timing affects the life history of animals from birth through senescence and death
